summary: An elderly victim was lured into a fraudulent cryptocurrency investment scheme through a fake Facebook advertisement. The scammers gained access to her device, manipulated her over an extended period with promises of large returns, and persuaded her to liquidate retirement savings, obtain loans, and mortgage her property, resulting in losses approaching 1 million USD.
user_mistake: Trusted an online investment opportunity promoted through social media and continued funding the scheme based on fabricated profits
prevention: Verify investment opportunities independently before sending funds / Discuss significant investment decisions with trusted family members or financial advisors
